adjudication_note: The coverage audit classified the top 200 unknown terms and found 126 of them ordinary Portuguese, which is why the 41.51 % target is unreachable by legitimate means. But the same audit surfaced real domain vocabulary still unregistered, and the anchor asks for a COMPLETE dictionary. Most conspicuous: `Growth` — I registered technical.value_investing during the precision campaign and never registered its counterpart, which the material always names as the other half of the same contrast. `subclasse` (62 occurrences) and `classe fechada` (22) are CVM 175 structure the registry had no word for at all.

concepts.def: The management style that selects companies expected to grow earnings faster than the market, contrasted with Value.
A subdivision of a class of fund shares, differing only in the features CVM 175 allows.
A class of shares whose rules do not allow redemption; the holder exits by selling.
A class of shares whose rules allow the holder to redeem.
The administrator or manager, whose services a fund cannot operate without.
The return a manager produced beyond the benchmark, the quantity attribution analysis decomposes.
The return of an asset assumed to carry no default risk, the baseline for excess return.
The study of how cognitive bias moves prices away from what efficient-market assumptions predict.
A ratio of price to a financial measure, used to judge whether a share is cheap or dear.
Building a portfolio to track an index rather than to beat it.
The party that owes the obligation and whose default triggers the credit event.
The completion of a trade by delivery of the asset and payment of the price.
